notes.title: Kin's Chronicle Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Now you can try out the first half of Act I for free, and see if Kin's Chronicle will be up your alley!

The Demo includes dozens of craftable weapons and armor, even more spells, and a host of minion and boss monsters for you to catch and upgrade as you adventure.

Please enjoy, and add us to your wishlist if you're eager to try the full version!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1617800/

notes.title: Heads up - save format change incoming!
notes.content:
In order to fix several bugs that have been lingering, I've had to change the save game file format a bit. This means your existing saves won't be able to be loaded, unfortunately.

To make this wipe worthwhile, I'll be delaying the next patch a bit to make sure you're not too bummed about your old Swolligators and Great Huge Snails. RIP, dear siblings! You contributed to greatness!

[h1][b]RUSTLE RUSTLE[/b][/h1]

notes.title: v0.23b alpha - Fixes and Features
notes.content:
New:[list]
[*]Added a Quickturn, mapped to "C" on Keyboard and L3 on gamepad by default
[*]Poison state now heals targets with Hinder element absorption on attack and per turn
[/list]

Enhancements:[list]
[*]Combat no longer starts when enemies are more than half a block above/below the player
[*]Updated barrel and pot shapes to use tree format instead of cross-shapes
[*]Name input screen resized and fonts centered
[*]Plugins updated for better enemy targeting and icon location in battle
[*]Include Kin's old Alignment when showing a new Alignment change
[*]Lowered Karkinos Sleeping with the Fishes probability and duration
[/list]

Fixes:[list]
[*]Losing to Karkinos no longer locks camera facing the wrong way
[*]Losing to Karkinos now sends player to the Grotto pool instead of the Cavern
[*]Grotto minecarts no longer reset after KO/teleport
[*]Several typos fixed and questlog word-wrapping corrected
[*]Enemies no longer try to "return home," causing pathing lag when failing to get there
[*]Changed the Gorge/Cavern "rumble" text popups to be queued instead of forced so they won't interrupt other notifications
[*]Music resumes properly now after a boss battle
[*]Losing to Carnivorous Plant no longer looks straight up into the air, cursing the gods
[/list]

notes.title: v0.23 alpha

-"Use the Portal" quest could complete without "Talk to the Woman" checked
-Cyrus won't wander and trap players in pools anymore
